Inform the Refugees of the new shelter the emperor has built for them.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find the refugees in Shenzun Tunnels.
* See [[Emperor's Hand]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
The hardest part of this quest is finding [[Imperial Guardsman Yang]] to get it. While he isn't far from the entrance to [[Zin Ku Corridor]], he is on a different level which requires going to the northern end of the area, climbing up, then heading back south, with several large groups of [[Jade Brotherhood]] along the way.

Once you have the quest, simply enter [[Shenzun Tunnels]] from [[Tahnnakai Temple (outpost)|Tahnnakai Temple]] and follow the quest marker. There are few foes along the way. Talk to all three refugees in the order indicated by the quest marker, then go to [[Raisu Pavilion]] to claim your reward.

==NPCs==

===Allies===
*{{x}} 10 (20) [[Refugee (Factions)|Refugee]] (x3)

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Imperial Guardsman Yang
:''"Many [[Cantha]]ns are being displaced from the city and forced down into the [[Shenzun Tunnels]] because they have nowhere else to go. By the emperor's orders, we have completed work on a public shelter. Find those in need of a home and bring word that they now have someplace to go. I am sure the [[Emperor's Hand]] will reward you well."''
